description: Call this when the user asks whether Kanal Varna comes to a specific city, district (квартал) or village — e.g. 'Младост', 'Аспарухово', 'Golden Sands', 'Аксаково', 'Добрич', 'Шумен', 'Burgas'. Accepts Bulgarian, Latin or Russian spelling. Returns yes (Varna), by_arrangement (region/villages — travel terms and timing agreed by phone) or not_listed, with the relevant page URL.

language.description: Language of the user's question: 'bg' (Bulgarian), 'en' (English), 'ru' (Russian) or 'de' (German; answers use English labels where no German text exists). If omitted it is detected from the text; default 'bg'.
language.title: Language

place.description: City, district or village name, e.g. 'Варна Чайка', 'Kavarna', 'с. Звездица'.
place.title: Place

name: check_service_area
title: Check if Kanal Varna serves a place
